summary: Code Coach demonstrates generating a complete Roblox battle royale UI in seconds using a custom plugin and Claude Opus with a one-shot prompt.

post.originalText: Some crate system and battle royale UI claude made in 2 seconds, all i did was write a one shot prompt "A cartoony battle royale: storm timer, players alive, inventory hotbar, minimap, emote wheel and a victory results screen" and it finished in Roblox Studio in 4 seconds. I am using my custom built roblox plugin for this, still a work in progress. Built in Opus 5.5 xhigh mode. Working on importing the map and will show you that aswell shortly. (You can of course change the crate icons with actual roblox items easily with a viewport frame but these icons were all made with basically no work and 1 click to make) I think it is came so far from when Claude first started making UI, what do you guys think?
